beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Negative results and abandoned decisions could retain value instead of disappearing from the final story.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Human responsibility remains important because a fluent account can still misrepresent the evidence.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Reports and articles become possible views of maintained knowledge rather than its only lasting container.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The reader can evaluate whether these changes reduce repeated work or merely add another maintenance obligation.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: A reviewer often spends time rebuilding the path between a claim and its support.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The book proposes review materials that expose relevant dependencies more directly.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Controlled access could provide necessary evidence without making all research materials public.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Selective transparency therefore concerns purpose and justified access, not secrecy disguised as rigor.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Continuing review would also need stable versions so criticism targets an identifiable account.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: These chapters connect editorial form with the practical work of evaluating a research programme.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The later chapters imagine changes to credit, careers, maintenance, and institutional incentives.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: They also examine fluent but empty accounts, platform dependence, inequality, and maintenance failure.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: A more coherent publication can make unsupported claims look more persuasive.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The proposed transition therefore needs tests that measure useful outcomes and the burden imposed.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Small pilots could examine whether reviewers spend less time reconstructing dependencies.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The book leaves room to reject arrangements whose maintenance costs outweigh their contribution.
